item.title: Design and Tapeout of a 64 Point FFT Module
item.description: Architected a low-area 64-point FFT module in Verilog, marking the first successful tapeout from IIT (BHU) Varanasi on SkyWater 130nm via TinyTapeout.

item.title: RISC-V CPU in Verilog HDL
item.description: 32-bit RV32IM CPU implemented in Verilog, validated via RTL testbenches and cross-compiled C benchmarks. Physical design flow targeting SkyWater 130nm tape-out.
